title: Step A · Create your Google client (once per Aquarium)
intro: Google only lets an app read Gmail, Calendar and Drive if the app is registered in Google Cloud. Each Aquarium registers its own, so your data never passes through anyone else's account. About 10 minutes; use a Google account that can create projects (a Workspace admin is best).
tick: Aquarium can't see your Google Cloud console, so tick each step when you've done it. Step 6 checks everything for real.
step2Body: Enable: Gmail, Calendar, Drive, People, Sheets, Docs.
step3Body: Open Google Auth Platform → Branding and fill in:
audience: Audience: choose Internal if everyone uses your company's Google Workspace. Otherwise choose External, add your colleagues as test users, then press Publish app so connections don't expire after 7 days.
unverified: Your team will see “Google hasn't verified this app”. That is expected for your own company's app: click Advanced → Go to Aquarium.
step4Body: Open Data access → Add or remove scopes → paste these into “Manually add scopes”, then Update and Save.
step5Body: Open Clients → Create client. Application type: Desktop app. Name: Aquarium. Click Create, then Download JSON.
redirect: Aquarium signs people in through this address. Desktop app clients accept it automatically; if you chose Web application, add it under Authorized redirect URIs:
step6Body: Upload the JSON file you downloaded, or paste the two values.
drop: Drop client_secret_….json here, or choose a file
ok: ✓ Google accepted this client. Step B is now open: each person connects their own account under Connected accounts.
note: Only the owner can do step A. The secret is stored on the server and is never shown again.
doneTitle: Step A is done: this Aquarium has a Google client.
doneEnv: It is set on the server (environment settings).
lastCheckBad: Last check: Google did not accept it.
replaceIntro: Replacing changes the client for everyone. People may need to connect their Google account again. The old client file is kept on the server as a backup.
replaceEnv: This client comes from the server settings. A client saved here is used instead.
stepB: Step B · Connect your Google account (each person)
stepBOpen: Each person connects their own Google account below, under Connected accounts.
loadError: Could not load the Google client status.
err_invalid_client: ✗ Google does not recognise this client ID and secret. Copy them again from Google Cloud → Clients.
err_redirect_mismatch: ✗ Google refused the sign-in address. If you chose Web application, add http://localhost:4321 under Authorized redirect URIs.
err_unreachable: ✗ Aquarium could not reach Google. Check the server's internet connection and try again.
err_unexpected: ✗ Google gave an unexpected answer. Check the values and try again.
err_client_exists: A Google client is already saved. Choose Replace client to change it.
err_not_json: That file is not a Google client file.
err_not_client_file: That file is not a Google OAuth client file. In Google Cloud, open Clients, pick the Aquarium client and press Download JSON.
err_too_large: That file is too large to be a Google client file.
err_bad_client_id: The client ID should end with .apps.googleusercontent.com.
err_generic: That didn't go through. Try again.
